task: M32 Noodles, native InertiaAndLowering and a conservative reference-axis inertia floor
first_start: negation of M35 elliptic crossing native coefficients; preserve the exterior of that cutter
second_start_selection: after initial_multiplier_nonpositive, choose a retained ellipsoid using the upper 97.5th percentile of the tip-frame Dprime vertices in a fixed triaxial metric; independent of model predictions and trial scores

shared_inputs: same fixed shell and unit density
same start, native spherical solver and inertia gate
same exact evaluator for each trial
paired_first_trial.budget_per_arm: one native trial from the initial anchor
paired_first_trial.acceptance: before native comparison reject if the independently integrated fixed-axis inertia lower bound falls below 90%; then apply the native residual rule
paired_first_trial.scope: pilot on one start. Training/setup/geometry cache and full-solve runtime are unmeasured. No end-to-end speed claim.
